FAQs

Everything you need to know,
at a glance

What is 1Fi?

1Fi is the world’s first mutual fund-backed no-cost EMI platform, letting you shop anything at 0% interest for upto 24 months.

Is 1Fi safe and legit?

Yes. 1Fi works with SEBI-approved RTAs for pledging and RBI-regulated lending partners for loans.

What documents are needed to take a loan?

No physical documents are required. You only need eligible mutual fund units, PAN, and Aadhaar. You can complete the loan in just 3 mins.

Are there any hidden fees?

No. We are fully transparent and do not charge processing, penal, bounce, foreclosure, setup, or lien-related charges.

What if markets fall?

Your limit may reduce so you may need to pledge more units or make a partial prepayment to be compliant with RBI regulations.

Are there any charges if I pay early to release pledged units?

No. You can partially prepay or fully foreclose anytime through 1Fi app without any charges and release your pledged mutual funds.
